name: DPM++ 2S Ancestral CFG++
plain: A CFG++ version of 2S that shifts x by the guidance gap before each exponential step. Nothing is dispatched to RF, so flow models run the −log σ formula. Reading the code shows the second update mixes values from two different model calls.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
get_ancestral_step: σ_up=min(σ', η·√(σ'²(σ²−σ'²)/σ²)); σ_down=√(σ'²−σ_up²); η=0 returns (σ', 0).
t=−log σ, t_d=−log σ_down, h=t_d−t, s=t+h/2.
U₁,D₁ from first call. x₂=(σ(s)/σ)(x+D₁−U₁)−(e^{−h/2}−1)D₁. Second call at σ(s) gives D₂ and overwrites stored U to U₂.
x'=(σ_down/σ)(x+D₁−U₂)−(e^{−h}−1)D₂. If σ'>0: x'+=n·s_noise·σ_up (s_noise×noise_scale).

props.stages: 2 (2 network passes each, cfg=1 shortcut off); 1 when σ_down=0
props.flow_const: No CONST branch, no RF dispatch; σ_up uses the VE get_ancestral_step on flow σ.

label: from code
surprise: temp[0] is overwritten by the second model call before line 1422 reads it, so the shift is D from stage 1 minus U from stage 2.
